column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key for system performance records (e.g., 501).
A TIMESTAMP capturing when this system performance record was logged.
An INT measuring system response time in milliseconds (e.g., 120).
An enum (errorcount_enum) capturing how many errors occurred (0–5).
An enum (cachestatus_enum) describing cache usage (Hit, Expired, Miss).
An enum (apiversion_enum) for the API version (v3, v2, v1).
A VARCHAR(50) storing the client version if relevant (e.g., 'web-1.2').
A TEXT field for feature flags or toggles (e.g., 'newUI, improvedSearch').
A BIGINT referencing Devices(DevKey), linking performance data to a device.
A BIGINT referencing Sessions(SeshKey), linking performance data to a session.
